request.query: Roth lemma polynomial separation generalized Wronskian determinant integer factors

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R

items.name: IsCoprime.wronskian_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {a b : Polynomial R},
  IsCoprime a b → (a.wronskian b = 0 ↔ Polynomial.derivative a = 0 ∧ Polynomial.derivative b = 0)

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_wronskian_lt_add
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {a b : Polynomial R},
  a.wronskian b ≠ 0 → (a.wronskian b).natDegree < a.natDegree + b.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_add_left
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b c : Polynomial R), (a + b).wronskian c = a.wronskian c + b.wronskian c

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_zero_left
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), Polynomial.wronskian 0 a = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_self_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), a.wronskian a = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskian_zero_right
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : Polynomial R), a.wronskian 0 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.wronskianBilin_apply
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b : Polynomial R), ((Polynomial.wronskianBilin R) a) b = a.wronskian b
